## Andy/Opus — Build 0193 VBlank Commit-First Reorder (STOP, no build)

- **Date:** 2026-07-16
- **Type:** Analysis-only state-causality of a proposed presentation reorder. No build. Repo stays at Build 0193.
- **Primary classification: B** (unsafe: current service must prepare sprites immediately before commit for coherence).
- **Data lifetimes traced (source):** ONLY the sprite SAT is produced inside _vblank_service (vdp_prepare_sprites, before commit); BG/FG plane, palette, and scroll staging are all produced by the ARCADE VINT after the tail jmp 0x3A208. Scroll-fill hooks are no-ops (KF-015); scroll enters staging via the arcade's redirected write during the arcade VINT.
- **Coherence proof:** current order commits SAT + planes all reflecting arcadeVINT_{N-1} (coherent, because prepare reads the fresh mirror right before commit). Commit-first commits SAT (prepare_{N-1} = arcadeVINT_{N-2}) against planes/scroll (arcadeVINT_{N-1}) -> sprites lag background by one frame -> tearing under motion (explicit STOP condition: mixes current scroll with previous pixels).
- **Options:** (1) full-snapshot commit-first needs double-buffering ~4.2K words (~0.4 frame copy / broad hook change) -> STOP; (2) sprites-only -> incoherent; (3) planes-only -> incoherent; (4) no-display-off -> replaces 5-line black band with 5-line DMA-glitch band mid-screen + real-HW risk; (5) NO BUILD (chosen).
- **Empirical:** over 900 gameplay frame-samples scroll changed 0x and SAT head-X changed 0x (game frozen: Rastan screen-X 0x80, scroll x=0/y=0x149). A reorder would LOOK safe now only because progression is frozen -- latent tearing once fixed; not a valid basis to ship.
- **Black-band root + recommended coherent fix:** service overruns one frame (prepare ~10 ms -> DISPLAY_OFF at ~line 124 mid-screen, rolls). Fix coherently by reducing prepare < ~2 ms (KF-053 scan/copy elimination: mirror writers now set candidates directly, so the 256-record scan is near-redundant + the 0x800 shadow copy is removable with a debug-gated invariant) so prepare+commit fits inside VBlank; or accept a stable (non-rolling) band by getting total service < 16.667 ms; a double-buffered snapshot commit-first is a separate larger task.
- **Structured metadata:** no owner exists for _vblank_service presentation ordering (spec tracks opcode/hook replacements, not instruction order) -- stated, not invented.
- **Open/Closed Issues Impact:** Open touched: OPEN-017. New: NONE. Closed: NONE. Deferred: prepare scan/copy elimination (coherent band fix), double-buffered snapshot commit (larger task).
- **KNOWN_FINDINGS impact:** KF-054 added (commit-first reorder unsafe without double-buffering; coherence dependency documented).
- **Architecture compliance:** CONFIRMED. No source change; Builds 0175/0178/0180/0192/0193 intact; mirror default 256.

## Andy/Opus — Exodus READY-Screen Loop Entry Trace (STOP, no build)

- **Date:** 2026-07-16
- **Type:** Static mapping + MAME reproduction of Tighe's Exodus-observed PCs. No build. Andy cannot run Exodus (used Tighe's PCs as external evidence).
- **Primary classification: A** (normal arcade sound-ready wait; Exodus missing the exit event MAME/BlastEm accidentally provide; F-flavored: 0x3E0003 read value differs by emulator).
- **Final lock:** runtime 0x3A33E-0x3A346 = TC0140SYT sound busy-wait. `bsr 0x3F29C` (write #4->0x3E0001; read 0x3E0003->d0); `btst #0,d0; bne` — waits while busy bit set. Enclosing routine 0x3A326 = sound-command dispatcher over slots A5+0x292..0x297, gated by A5@(0x34)/A5@(0x1394).
- **Root:** 0x3E0000-0x3E0003 = arcade TC0140SYT, absent on Genesis. Spec suppresses TC0140SYT WRITES but NOT the status READ (0x3F0A4). 0x3E0003 is out-of-physical-ROM cartridge space (ROM 1.58 MB, addr ~3.87 MB) -> emulator open bus. MAME=0x00 (bit0=0) loop EXITS (verified: 0x3E0003 hist 0x00x297/0xFFx3; 0x3A346 loopback=3, exit=3; D0=0x00010000 bit0=0). Exodus returns bit0=1 -> spins.
- **0x702xx loops:** normal bounded VBlank dbf commit loops (vdp_commit_palette 64-word CRAM copy; vdp_commit_fg_strips 64-word per dirty row) — classification G, not the lock.
- **Exodus checklist for Tighe:** break 0x3A342 inspect D0 (expect low byte 0x00/bit0=0; Exodus stuck bit0=1); inspect byte 0x3E0003 (MAME 0x00; Exodus bit0=1 confirms); break 0x3F2A4 confirm the read; verify no Genesis write to 0x3E0003; check A5+0x292 slots non-zero (queued command).
- **Proposed fix (NOT built, for Tighe's call):** redirect the status read 0x3F0A4 (0x3E0003) to return bit0=0, or route the handshake (0x3F084 send / 0x3F09C status) through the Z80 sound path (sound_comm.s/z80_write_command). Never NOP/force the loop. Consistent with the existing "suppress TC0140SYT writes; drive sound via Z80" strategy.
- **Metadata:** spec suppresses TC0140SYT writes but has no owner for the read-side handshake -- documented as incomplete-for-this-class; no metadata change made (no build).
- **Open/Closed Issues Impact:** Open touched: OPEN-017, OPEN-003. New: NONE. Closed: NONE. Deferred: TC0140SYT read-side redirect / Z80 handshake (awaiting Tighe's go).
- **KNOWN_FINDINGS impact:** KF-055 added (Exodus sound busy-wait open-bus lock).
- **Architecture compliance:** CONFIRMED. No source/metadata change; Build 0193 intact; mirror 256.
- **STOP triggered:** YES (analysis complete; no build; fix proposed pending Tighe).

- **Design:** replace the leaf routines with native emitters writing final-format shadows (double-buffered link-ordered SAT 2x640B, dirty-column plane ring, CRAM shadow, code-keyed per-scene residency manifests from the arcade's own ROM layout tables); composite merging 16x16->32x32 (lizard 8->2 sprites); delete mirror/shadow/candidates/represent/tall-buffers/projections; keep ALL gameplay state, collision map (fix KF-067 there), palette route table, arcade execution+VBlank ownership. - **Migration:** N1 native sprite pipeline (architectural proof, deletes mirror stack) -> N2 native planes (+KF-067 joint fix, deletes 24.5KB buffers) -> N3 merging + scene manifests -> N4 palette/scroll consolidation. Each stage deletes what it replaces; numbered builds are the rollback path; MAME arcade=authority, current Genesis=baseline, BlastEm/Exodus/Nomad acceptance.
- **Answer to mandate:** YES — arcade-faithful native re-emission at the measured leaf boundaries, retaining only genuinely-read RAM structures.

## Andy — Canonical Arcade PC080SN Scene Init & Tilemap0 Producers (checkpoint, reference-only)

- **Date:** 2026-07-26 · NO source/spec/tool/ROM/counter/artifact change. Counter 238. New: docs/arcade_reference/pc080sn/{scene_initialization.c, scene_initialization_assembly.md, tilemap0_producers.md}; updated README/address_index/state_fields/access_inventory/unresolved.
- **Scene init (0x0503E4):** 64-iteration fill loop. Seeds cursors (tilemap1 a5@0x10A0/0x10A4=0xC08000, tilemap0 0x10D0F8=0xC00000; **sel==1 seeds a5@0x10A4 = 0xC0BF00** = tilemap1 row 63, decrement 0x100/iter → fills tilemap1 rows 63→0 = 0xC08000–0xC0BFFF). *(CORRECTED: the earlier "sel==1 uses 0xC04000" was a decimal→hex slip; 12631808 = 0xC0BF00, not 0xC04000.)* Each iter calls 0x055948 (tilemap1 strip) + 0x55C4A (tilemap0 strip) → fills BOTH tilemaps at setup.
- **Tilemap0 producer chain 0x55C4A→0x55C5E→0x55C7A:** cursor a5@0x10F8 (0xC00000), tables 0x10D100/0x10D104, 64 sub-cells/strip, +256 stride, **NO collision** (no 0x10DE00 write). Callers: 0x050438 (scene fill) + 0x055B8E. **CORRECTION (hardware-mapping verify checkpoint):** 0x055B8E is the gameplay VERTICAL tilemap0 streamer (the 0x055B60 routine publishes a strip on each 8px vertical crossing, dest 0xC00000+(a5@0x10F4<<6)+(a5@0x10F6<<2)). **Tilemap0 IS gameplay-active** — it streams vertically AND parallax-scrolls; the earlier "static/scene-init-only" claim was wrong (it came from reading the Y register during a horizontal-only test).
- **Selectors 4/5/6 RESOLVED as non-publication map commands:** the direction dispatcher matches only 0/1/2 so 4/5/6 publish nothing; consumed by event/scene logic (0x05127C position-gated spawns via a5@0x11DE; 0x527CC sets a5@0x10E8=7). Exact per-value game effect = scene/event logic (out of PC080SN scope).
- **Tilemap roles + scroll axes (CORRECTED, runtime-verified):** the "layer A/B" labels are dropped. Proven axes: horizontal movement changes **0xC40000/2 = X-scroll**; **0xC20000/2 = Y-scroll** (static in a horizontal-only test only because Y didn't move — NOT because tilemap0 is static). Offset 0 moves at HALF the rate of offset 2 ⇒ **offset 0 = tilemap0 (half-rate parallax background)**, **offset 2 = tilemap1 (full-rate playfield + collision)**. Scroll commit 0x055AB4: 0xC20000=a5@0x10EE (tm0 Y), 0xC40000=a5@0x10EC (tm0 X, half-rate `lsrw #1`), 0xC20002=a5@0x10B0 (tm1 Y), 0xC40002=a5@0x10AE (tm1 X).
- **C-window clear 0x0561B6:** fills BOTH maps with 0x00000020 (word0=0x0000, word1=0x0020) → **0x0020 = blank/base tile**; clear-state word0=0x0000 vs streamed word0=0x0003.
- **Quadrants (CORRECTED):** 0xC04000 is NOT content-written by the scene-fill; it is BG rowscroll RAM (m_bgscroll_ram[0], Topspeed-only) reached only by independent clear paths (boot 0x00054A, frontend 0x03AF52). 0xC0C000 = FG rowscroll RAM, clear-only. Rastan uses global scroll, never per-line.
- **Handoff:** after 0x0503E4 both maps hold 64 cols; gameplay then walks the map byte stream (a5@0x10C6) via 0x0558E0, recomputing tilemap1 cursors per crossing (fill-loop cursor values overwritten). Persistent state = descriptor tables 0x10D000/0x10D040/0x10D080 (tm1) + 0x10D100/0x10D104 (tm0).
- **MAME captures used:** 1 (scroll-pair↔tilemap wiring). **Checkpoint complete: YES.** Remaining: 4/5/6 event effects; word0 bits; 0xC0C000; text-writer per-cell targets.

## Andy — PC080SN Hardware Format Verified vs Official MAME Source (checkpoint, reference-only)

- **Date:** 2026-07-26 · NO source/spec/tool/ROM/counter/artifact change. Counter 238, source git-clean vs bad1499. Trigger: user supplied `github.com/mamedev/mame/tree/master/src/mame/taito`. Fetched `pc080sn.cpp` + `rastan.cpp`. Updated: README (authority order +MAME source, hardware ranges, status), scene_initialization_assembly §8/§9/§10, unresolved. All prior "source-blocked" hardware items now RESOLVED.
- **Cell format (pc080sn.cpp get_tile_info):** word1 = `code & 0x3FFF` (14-bit tile code); word0 = attr: colour `attr & 0x1FF`, flip `(attr & 0xC000)>>14` via TILE_FLIPYX ⇒ **bit14 = X-flip, bit15 = Y-flip**. Streamed word0 0x0003 = colour 3 no flip; clear 0x0000 = colour 0.
- **RAM→tilemap (word_w):** tilemap0 = offset 0x0000–0x1FFF (0xC00000); tilemap1 = 0x4000–0x5FFF (0xC08000); 0xC04000–0xC041FF / 0xC0C000–0xC0C1FF = BG/FG rowscroll RAM (m_bgscroll_ram, Topspeed-only), remainder unused ⇒ not a third tilemap. *(The scene-fill does NOT write 0xC04000 — see the 0x050420 correction entry below.)*
- **Scroll (xscroll/yscroll_word_w):** xscroll off0/1 = tilemap0/tilemap1 X (0xC40000/2); yscroll off0/1 = tilemap0/tilemap1 Y (0xC20000/2); stored negated. **Exactly matches the runtime-verified axes.**
- **Draw order (rastan.cpp screen_update, definitive):** tilemap0 `TILEMAP_DRAW_OPAQUE` prio1 (back) → tilemap1 transparent prio2 (playfield, over) → PC090OJ sprites (front). gfx = gfx_8x8x4_packed_msb, 0x80 colour codes. Confirms tm0 = opaque parallax background, tm1 = transparent full-rate playfield, sprites frontmost.
- **Remaining unknowns:** tile 0x0020 decoded-gfx pixel bytes only; 4/5/6 event effects; 0xC0C000; text-writer per-cell targets. **No remaining source-blocked hardware items.**
- **MAME captures used:** 0 (static source review). **Checkpoint complete: YES.**

## Andy — 0x050420 Scene-Fill Constant Correction (0xC0BF00) + Reference Reconcile (checkpoint, reference-only)

- **Date:** 2026-07-26 · NO source/spec/tool/ROM/counter/artifact change. Counter 238, production source git-clean vs bad1499 (Build 0235). Reference-only edits under docs/arcade_reference/pc080sn/ + corrected prior recent entries in place.
- **Root fix (machine-verified):** ROM opcode at 0x050420 = `20 3C 00 C0 BF 00` = `move.l #0xC0BF00,d0` → stores 0xC0BF00 into a5@0x10A4. **12631808 = 0xC0BF00, NOT 0xC04000** (prior decimal→hex slip). 0xC0BF00 = 0xC08000 + 0x3F00 = **tilemap1 row 63, col 0**.
- **Selector-1 geometry (re-derived from opcodes, Capstone m68k on reconstructed maincpu image):** chain 0x0503DC→0x050434→0x055948→0x055990(strip_B)→0x055A14. Cell producer writes 4 cells×4 bytes=0x10/call; strip_B 16 calls=0x100 bytes=one 64-tile row; 64 outer iters, a5@0x10A4 −= 0x100/iter → fills tilemap1 rows 63→0 = **0xC08000–0xC0BFFF exactly** (4096 cells). No overlap, no wrap, no write to 0xC0C000+ or 0xC04000. Cross-check: 0xC0BF00 = the gameplay selector-1 dispatcher's initial dest (0xC08000+0x3F00 at ring-counter 0).
- **Independent 0xC04000 sites:** 0x00054A (boot clear), 0x03AF52 (frontend clear). 0xC04000/0xC0C000 = BG/FG rowscroll RAM (m_bgscroll_ram, Topspeed-only) per official MAME pc080sn.cpp; Rastan uses global scroll only, clears these regions, never streams content there.
- **Callers of the fill routine 0x0503DC:** one direct — 0x050206 (in scene-reinit routine 0x0501E2, gated by a5@0x13E2≠1 → runs on scene reinit, not per frame); 0x0501E2 ← jsr 0x045316 (stage entry). Selector source = a5@0x10A8 (map byte, written by 0x0558F8).
- **Reconcile:** scene_initialization.c stale "tilemap0 static / 055B8E unproven" comments corrected (tilemap0 = gameplay-active parallax BG streamed via 0x055B8E); access_inventory word0 bits decoded (0–8 colour, 14 X-flip, 15 Y-flip) + "four quadrants" language removed (2 tilemaps + 2 rowscroll/unused); tilemap0 producer set marked documented; unresolved.md trimmed to genuine unknowns (clear_fill_tile_0x0020 pixels; 4/5/6 event effects out-of-scope; text-writer per-cell targets); 0x0561B6 = clear-fill pair only (not proven-blank).

## Andy — Canonical Arcade Map-Stream Format & Scene Selection (checkpoint, reference-only)

- **Date:** 2026-07-26 · NO source/spec/tool/ROM/counter/artifact change. Counter 238, production source git-clean vs bad1499. New: docs/arcade_reference/pc080sn/{map_stream_format.md, map_stream_control.c}. Updated: README, access_inventory, address_index, state_fields, gameplay_control.c, gameplay_control_assembly.md, unresolved. All facts re-derived from ROM opcodes (Capstone m68k).
- **Pointer source:** map-stream pointer a5@0x10C6 (0x10D0C6) — init at 0x0503D6 (`= 0x50F6B + byte[0x50EE0 + a5@0x13E]`), advance +1/byte at 0x0558E4 (per ring cycle). Only two writers.
- **Scene selection chain:** STAGE a5@0x1242 → byte[0x5073A] → segment index a5@0x13E → { map ptr a5@0x10C6 = 0x50F6B + 0x50EE0[seg]; 16 strip-source bases = ROM_tbl[i] + seg×0x40 (tables 0x1691C…0x3725C, 0x22C0 apart); tm0 idx a5@0x1386 = 0x507C5[seg] → tm0 src a5@0x10FC = 0x3951C + idx×0xC }. Runs in scene-reinit 0x0501E2 (0x050202 selection + 0x050206 fill), gated a5@0x13E2≠1; ← jsr 0x045316.
- **Stream format:** flat byte array at 0x50F6B (~157 B); LUT 0x50EE0 = 139-byte segment→offset table (a5@0x13E ∈ [0,138]). Each byte = one selector, NO inline operands.
- **Byte values:** 0=horizontal (strip_A), 1=vertical-A (strip_B), 2=vertical-B (strip_B flipped); 4/5/6=non-publication events (0x05127C position-gated flags; 0x527CC a5@0x10E8=7); 3/7 inert (no consumer; 7 = scene/segment-end marker); 0xFF = end-of-data guard. Histogram (157 B): 0×128,1×8,2×3,4×6,6×6,7×7,0xFF×1 (no 5 in region).
- **Publication unit per byte:** ONE 64-position ring cycle = a5@0x10CA(0→3)×a5@0x10CC(0→15) = 64 publications; each publication = one strip (64 cells) → 4096 cells = 512 px. Advance at 0x0558E0 when a5@0x10CC hits 16. Stalled camera → byte stays active.
- **Termination/transition:** no per-byte terminator on the selector path; streams don't self-chain; progression via STAGE re-seed (0x05025A) + checkpoint re-seed (0x055F26/0x056014). Out-of-range selectors inert.
- **Corrections made:** the "selector mirror / horizontal gate" field is **a5@0x132C** (0x0558EC write, 0x0557DC read), NOT 0x136C — decimal 4908 = 0x132C (fixed state_fields, gameplay_control.c/.md). README stale "BG/FG roles not established" warning removed (roles proven). access_inventory reconstruction order marked items 1/2/2b DONE.
- **Remaining unknowns:** exact event-byte stream-step (+2 LUT deltas); selector 5/7 exact roles; per-value 4/5/6 event effects (enemy/scene subsystem, out of scope); 0x502AC special-segment set. **Checkpoint complete: YES.**

## Andy — Map-Stream Record & Event-Transition Correction (checkpoint, reference-only)

- **Date:** 2026-07-26 · NO source/spec/tool/ROM/counter/artifact change. Counter 238, production source git-clean vs bad1499. Corrects overclaims in the prior map-stream entry (in place). - **Records are VARIABLE-LENGTH** (machine-derived from LUT 0x50EE0). Indices 0–137 (proven via deltas): 120 one-byte + 18 two-byte records. **Every two-byte record = [direction ∈{0,1}, event ∈{4,6,7}]** (not two independent commands). Record 138: first byte 0x00 proven; candidate `[00 07]` + candidate 0xFF sentinel (no LUT[139]). *(Corrected below from the earlier "120+19 / 158 proven".)*
- **Publication unit corrected:** the 64-publications-per-byte (4×16 ring, 64-cell strips, 512 px) applies ONLY to DIRECTION selectors 0/1/2. Event bytes 4/6/7 publish nothing.
- **Event freeze PROVEN; completion route DOWNGRADED (corrected in the next entry).** a5@0x10C6 + a5@0x13E advance +1 per completed ring cycle (0x0558E4/0x0558FE), walking the RAW stream. An event byte publishes nothing → ring never completes → **walk FREEZES** on it (a5@0x10E8=7 at 0x0527CC; enemy/scene engine reads it at 0x0540CC/0x051598/0x0517D8). **MAME-verified:** corrupting a5@0x10C6 mid-play persisted, and changing a5@0x13E alone did NOT move it → walk-driven, not recomputed each frame. *(The earlier claim that event completion routes through 0x045316→scene-init to re-seed, and that stage-LUT targets are "the" post-event segments, is DOWNGRADED — see the correction entry below.)*
- **a5@0x13E writers (from valid boundaries):** 0x05025A (scene-init = 0x5073A[stage]), 0x0558FE (+1/ring), 0x055F26 (death-restore = a5@0x13B8, phase-8 of the a5@0x13AA state machine at 0x055E00), 0x056014 (death-restore = a5@0x13B8−1). a5@0x10C6 writers: 0x0503D6 (re-seed), 0x0558E4 (+1). Single role for a5@0x13E = **segment index** (was mislabeled "publish counter").
- **Selector 7:** a5@0x10A8 is only cmpi'd vs {0,1,2,4,5,6} and copied to 0x132C — no range check, no table dispatch → **"observed value 7; no consumer established"** (removed the prior "inert/scene-end marker" label). **0xFF:** never read as a selector → **candidate sentinel**, not a proven terminator.
- **Stream boundary (machine-calc, corrected):** first 0x050F6B; **157 bytes proven through offset 0x9C**; 0x9D(0x07)/0x9E(0xFF)/0x9F(0x0C) are candidate 2nd-byte / candidate sentinel / following structure. 158 data bytes only if the candidate 0x07 is accepted. Histogram (0x00–0x9D, 158): 00×128,01×8,02×3,04×6,06×6,07×7.
- **Consistency fixes:** a5@0x13E one role (segment index) across files; removed stale "tilemap0 producer set unresolved" (address_index/core_publishers_assembly); 0x055E54 marked documented; direction-cycle vs event-record behaviour distinguished; unproven inert/terminator labels removed.
- **Checkpoint complete: YES.**

## [Andy — Plane A Semantic Cut Contract] (research only)

- **Date:** 2026-07-28. No production source / spec / build / counter change (240).
- **Deliverable:** `docs/design/Andy_plane_a_semantic_cut_contract.md`.
- **Selected cut (all four Plane A ops):** the **cell-producer boundary** — `0x0559B2` (selector-0 column) and `0x055A14` (selector-1/2 row). Same two points serve scene-fill and gameplay; they differ only in dispatch caller + selector.
- **Not the driver boundary (0x055968/0x055990):** the drivers own the a1/a3 descriptor walk and the `a5@0x10A0 = a0` save, and the scene-fill loop depends on a0 ending at `base+0x4000` so its `-=0x3FFC` nets **+4/column**. Proven from 0x0503DC/0x050444: producer advances a0 by +0x4000, fill loop subtracts 0x3FFC → +4 (matches 0xC08000→0xC08100 over 64). Cutting at the driver reproduces that whole bookkeeping = the exact Build 0240 stall surface (a5@0x10A0 stuck 0xC08004). Cell-producer cut keeps driver+save+fill arcade-owned; helper only advances a0 +0x100/cell and produces final Plane A + collision.
- **Complete chip tail removed:** the two `movew …, a0@` C08000 name-RAM word writes/cell (word0 attr + word1 tile) × 4 cells × 16 segments in 0x0559B2 and 0x055A14 — the entire PC080SN tilemap1 name-RAM population. Collision (→0x10DE00), a0 advance, and source reads are REPRODUCED, not removed.
- **Classification:** semantic-retain = descriptor tables 0x10D000/40/80, strip index 0x10CA, selector 0x10A8, scroll 0x10AE/0x10B0, collision src/dest; a5@0x10A0/0x10A4 = AMBIGUOUS→RETAIN (position + collision base + loop counter; value is arcade position, C08000 *dereference* is chip→REMOVE); C08000 *arithmetic* (position + collision addr) = RETAIN.
- **Collision ownership:** RETAIN/REPRODUCE for all 64 logical cells regardless of visual residency.
- **Build 0240:** reusable = arcade tables + rebuild 0x55904, LUT conversion, residency math, collision concept. Retire = the native column path that suppressed the arcade a0 advance and assumed +4 instead of +0x4000-then-−0x3FFC; `fg_native_owner` cursor-advance suppression.
- **Unresolved blockers (implementation, not boundary):** exact a0 stride byte-match; word0 attribute semantics; selector-2 strip complement; Plane A residency logical→physical.
- **Recommended first Cody task:** replace ONLY 0x0559B2 (selector-0 column cells); leave row/Plane B/dispatch/drivers/fill untouched; accept when a5@0x10A0 advances identically to Build 0235 with no stall and collision intact.
- **STOP:** not triggered. No implementation prompt written in the document.

## [Andy — Corrected Plane A Semantic Cut Contract] (research only)

- **Date:** 2026-07-28. No production source / spec / build / counter change (240). Revised `docs/design/Andy_plane_a_semantic_cut_contract.md` (rev 2).
- **Build 0240 root corrected:** proven cause = `.Lfg_native_convert_cell` clobbers live caller registers (uses d3/d4/d5/d7/a2/a3, `rts` with NO save/restore) → the arcade publication/segment loop (holds counter/table ptrs in a1/a3/d1) never terminates → READY hang. `a5@0x10A0=0xC08004` / `a5@0x10AA=0x003F` were symptoms of the hung loop, NOT a bookkeeping fault. Withdrew the earlier attribution to fg_native_owner / cursor suppression / +4 arithmetic (no evidence they were faults). Lesson: helpers called inside arcade loops must save/restore every non-owned register.
- **Cut re-evaluated / earlier conclusion withdrawn:** 0x0559B2/0x055A14 consume PC080SN-shaped state (C08000 dest cursor, word0/word1 layout, +0x100 stride, collision via chip address) → classified **transitional cell-write interception, NOT the final semantic cut** (policy §2 litmus).
- **Boundary ladder:** 0x050434 = MIXED (semantic publish wrapped in C08000 seed + −0x3FFC back-step); 0x055948 dispatch = SEMANTIC (highest pure-semantic point; delegates position to the C08000-cursor driver); 0x055968/0x055990 = MIXED semantic/chip (semantic descriptor walk + chip C08000 cursor/stride); 0x0559B2/0x055A14 = FULLY PC080SN-specific.
- **Final cut = NOT YET SELECTABLE → STOP.** The arcade does not expose logical (row,col) independently of the C08000 cursor a5@0x10A0/0x10A4 (the cursor IS the position source-of-truth; collision is indexed via (a0-0xC08000)>>1). Logical recovery from ring counters (0x10CA/0x10CC) + scroll (0x10AE/0x10B0) + selector is possible in principle (collision map 0x10DE00 is logically addressed as 0x10DE00+(row·64+col)·2), but not yet proven to match a0 across fill/gameplay/selectors/sel-2 reversal/ring wrap.
- **Classification:** semantic tables 0x10D000/40/80 = RETAIN; a5@0x10A0/0x10A4 = **chip-format cursor, REMOVE target** (not a semantic field); collision destination must become logical (row,col) indexing, not chip-address.
- **Cody implementation recommended:** NO. Next step = prove logical (row,col)+collision indexing from ring+scroll vs runtime a0. A transitional cell-producer experiment may be documented separately (register-safe), never as the target architecture.
- **STOP:** triggered on final-cut selection.

## [Andy — Analysis, Build 0249 Native Genesis Sprite Architecture + First Migration Slice]

- **Date:** 2026-08-02. **Classification:** sprite architecture finalization + first migration contract / native PC090OJ (Part II of the pre-PC090OJ producer doc). No production source, remap spec, ROM, build, or counter change; Build 0249 / counter 249 (RASTAN_GAMEPLAY_HUD_SPRITES=2).

- **Architecture correction (semantic priority queues, NOT a single global cursor):** producer EXECUTION order (master 0x41DAE: players→grp2→grp3→grp4) ≠ final PRIORITY order (record index 46<57<96<140). So a producer cannot always append to one global SAT cursor. Final model = per-class compact queues concatenated front-to-back at finalization. Semantic classes (front→back), named by arcade producer ownership: 0 fixed-front-HUD (0x3B802/0x5A098, rec0-45), 1 front-effects/bats/items (grp4 0x748, rec46-56), 2 player (0x41F5E block + grp1, rec92-95/120-137), 3 middle objects (grp2 0x5C8, rec96-119), 4 back enemies/lizards (grp3 0x2C8, rec140-238). Record ranges are ORACLE evidence only, never runtime ownership. Records 239-255 have no producer → class 4 is the true tail.
- **Native queue format/ownership:** `back_enemy_queue` = compact array of target-shaped entries {Y9, size(16x16), attr(pri|flip|code), X9} + parallel colbank nibble (resolved at commit as today). Entry must NOT contain an 8-byte record, PC090OJ address, record number, object-RAM cursor, or 0x0180/blank sentinel (entries exist only for visible pieces). Native subsystem owns queue+count; arcade still owns traversal/lifecycle/animation/mapping/coords/visibility. No Genesis actor loop/scheduler.
- **Boundaries (address_map-pinned runtime):** RESET = top of `genesistan_pc090oj_hook_target_41dae` (0x72A98, arcade 0x41DAE sprite-prep) set count=0 before stage_block2c8; CONCAT/FINALIZE = `pc090oj_native_emit_pass` (0x731E4) becomes hybrid finalizer; VBLANK = `vdp_commit_sprites` (0x7349C) DMA staged_sprite_sat→VRAM 0xF800 unchanged. `vdp_prepare_sprites` (0x7348E) is inactive legacy scan.
- **Hybrid frame order:** count=0 → converted stage_block2c8 (0x72B6C) enqueues native lizard pieces via arcade engine 0x3D254 into a TRANSIENT scratch then translate (KF-067 Y-8) → back_enemy_queue, writing ZERO object_ram 140-238; inactive/retired/blank enqueue nothing → stage_record46 (compat mirror) → emit pass scans 0..255 SKIPPING 140-238 (emit compat classes 0-3, no terminate) → walk back_enemy_queue front-to-back emitting via existing residency/slot path (continues cursor+link) → terminate last slot. Class 4 = tail so concat is append-after; general case = §11 class-queue concatenation.
- **Duplicate prevention:** converted producer writes 0 records to 140-238; finalizer excludes 140-238 (single range guard, symmetric with HUD #46/#9 guards). Both run inside the one hook invocation in fixed order → every lizard piece emitted exactly once.
- **SAT link/residency:** one continuous chain — emit pass link=cursor+1 per entry, queue phase continues same cursor, terminator on last emitted slot; NATIVE_SAT_MAX=80 cap spans both phases (drop-tail drops back-enemy pieces first). Tile residency REUSED (same .Lnep_res_ok / 32-set×4-way cache / cell_used protection / 12-entry tile_dma_worklist); lizard residency resolved after classes 0-3 protect cells → identical eviction ordering. No second residency impl.
- **Recurring cost (measured, lizcost.txt):** lizard-band mirror writes = ~54 (light) to ~132-154 (heavy, emitted 40-50) word-writes/frame. Native path eliminates the mirror round-trip for the band (~54-154 writes + their re-read), the separate KF-067 Y-fix pass (~32 RMW), the 99-record blank pre-scan, and ~32 8-byte decodes ≈ ~150-300 fewer mem-ops/frame at heavy load; engine expansion + residency + SAT DMA UNCHANGED. NOT a large speedup — primary win is architectural (mirror stops being class-4 authority). No speed claim beyond the measured basis. Boot-only DMA + inactive candidate scan excluded.
- **HUD scope DEFERRED (recorded note only):** HUD/status may stay entirely native sprites; Window/Plane A reconsidered only after full PC090OJ removal + real sprite-limit measurement. Supersedes the prior §7 Window decision (now deferred, not adopted). No HUD work in slice 1.
- **PC090OJ removal sequence:** slice1 class4 lizards → slice2 class1 effects/bats (delivers Build 0234 fix) → slice3 classes 2/3 player+middle → slice4 class0 HUD → slice5 delete object_ram/D00000 xlate/record packing/record_to_slot/mirror scans/decoders/chip clear-copy-decay(0x3B902/26/30,0x41F5E,0x5607C,0x56xxx,0x59F5E,0x3AD44)/Y=0x180/PC090OJ BSS+symbols+remap; keep+rename staged_sprite_sat+residency+tile DMA under native subsystem; keep colbank shadow (proven semantic).
- **STOP: NOT triggered** (lizard path needs no record packing as authority; ownership is semantic class not record number; duplicate impossible; priority preserved; reset/finalize proven; residency reused; no Genesis traversal/scheduler).

## Andy — Ghidra Specialized Sprite Provenance (analysis only, counter 258)

Resolved the semantic ownership of the retained artwork-code (+4) and attribute (+0) fields used by the eight
specialized sprite handlers, using the existing Ghidra project decompiler export + xrefs, verified against
build/maincpu.disasm.txt / build/regions/maincpu.bin. No production source, remap, generated object, or ROM
changed; counter stays 258.

- Root cause of "missing" handlers: Ghidra folded 0x3c4d2..0x3c8f6 into FUN_0003d054/FUN_0003c902 via computed
  jumps (FUN_0003d054 entry 0x3d054, body_min 0x3c4d2). The eight are jump-table case bodies inlined in the type
  dispatcher FUN_0003c902; all present in the export. No function boundaries had to be added/corrected.
- Two-level dispatch: master build FUN_00041dae -> FUN_0003d054 (family a4@0x38) -> FUN_0003c902 (type *a0&0xF0)
  -> case bodies / default expander 0x3c950. Type is class-fixed (a0 = family_base + u16[class*2]).
- attr@+0 owner = actor attribute byte a4@39 (FUN_0003c9e8 btst#6/move.b a4@(39)); set at spawn via attribute
  table 0x45376/45388/456b6/45c04. NONE of the eight handlers writes +0 (scan of 0x3c4d2..0x3c902 for ,%a1@(0)
  empty).
- code@+4 owner = actor base tile a4@30/a4@24 (spawn writes 0x40cf0..0x426dc) + mapping code byte (default
  expander FUN_0003c8f6). Only handler 0x10 (FUN_0003c89a @0x3c8b8) writes +4 — stage recompute (0x0A0D+facing
  +level, gated area a5@0x118==3). Sole ,%a1@(4) store in region = 0x3c8b8.
- Persistence: FUN_00041dae gives each actor slot a fixed object-RAM band; specialized handlers rewrite Y/X
  only; park writes Y=0x180 only; chip clear FUN_0003ad72 is boot/reset only (callers startup_common_body,
  warm_restart_gate_caller_a). So attr/code persist per-slot from spawn.
- Decision: retained fields are actor-owned (a4@30/a4@39/mapping/stage), not chip state. Native = Option B
  actor-owned native_piece_metadata {artwork_code, palette_route, flip_x, flip_y, valid}, with Option-A
  read-through refresh for default-type frames and handler-0x10 area-3 code. PC090OJ gameplay state required:
